prompt:

Header text verbatim: "hög". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "high".
Scene: A person looking up at a very high stone wall, strong vertical sense of scale.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "hög = high; look up toward the top.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Muren är mycket hög.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
